# AI Usage Disclosure

## Tools Used

- **GitHub Copilot** (Claude Sonnet 4) — agentic coding mode in IDE

## How It Was Used

- **Agentic coding**: Used to generate the initial structure of the chess game files based on detailed requirements and the existing ProjectSkeleton code.
- **Code suggestions**: Auto-completed some repetitive patterns (piece rendering, move validation cases).

## Fully AI-Generated Files / Regions

None of the files are fully AI-generated verbatim. All files were generated with AI assistance and then reviewed, understood, and adjusted by the author. The code structure, game logic, and rendering approach were guided by the author's design decisions.

## Summary

AI was used as a coding assistant to speed up implementation. All code has been reviewed by the author.
The LLM helped me more about stuff that I forgot, such as en passant and castling, and also helped me with the rendering of the pieces. He implemented these on the code I had originally.
It helped me more on the UX side, such as the valid move highlighting and the turn indicator.
The ideea of the classes and the functions were originally corected and made by me, obviously with LLMs help.
